text:
kevin_sales: Starting thread for Novabank early POC. Need quick answers: SAML flow, SCIM auth, RBAC mapping, domain verification, and committed Dedicated estimate.

tara_se: Quick checklist: IdP metadata, nameID format, groups payload, SCIM auth type, target region for data residency.

client_ops_novabank: We'll provide IdP metadata URL today. Prefer SP-initiated, nameID=email. SCIM via bearer token acceptable for POC; rotation 90 days. EU region for production.

oliver_ts: For RBAC, do you want group->role mapping or attribute-based roles? Also confirm externalId field.

client_ops_novabank: Group->role mapping. We'll use externalId and will include employeeType attribute for hints.

nina_security: Security notes: 1) Recommend mTLS in prod; POC token ok. 2) Audit logs default 90d; can do 365d for enterprise (extra cost). 3) Domain verification via DNS TXT, ~1-3 business days per domain. Need completed security questionnaire.

tara_se: SCIM sample we'll use for testing: {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"],"Resources":[{"id":"u-42","userName":"a.user@novabank.com","externalId":"novabank|42","emails":[{"value":"a.user@novabank.com"}],"groups":["payments"]}]}
Mapping: payments->payments-analyst. SCIM rate-limit for initial sync: 50 req/min.

kevin_sales: Pricing ask: committed Dedicated for 100-130 req/s, ~1M tokens/day. Need monthly reserved + overage, support add-ons, and logging options. Oliver, can you draft an estimate and include caveats?

oliver_ts: Yes. I'll include reserved GPU pool cost, overage per 1k tokens, 24/7 support line item, and note that quantized models or lower-latency SLOs may change commit.

client_ops_novabank: Legal needs SSO/SCIM SOW clause before budget sign-off.

legal_bot: Template SOW: /templates/sow/identity-brief.md. Key items: metadata exchange, cert rotation, provisioning termination, data residency.

nina_security: I'll fill the security QA and draft the minimal SOW clause. Note: per-route RBAC and per-route logging will increase implementation scope and cost.

deploybot: Deploy queued: feature/poc-id-config -> staging 2024-10-14T09:00Z

kevin_sales: Good. Tara + Oliver to start config once metadata + token received. Nina to send QA. Sync tomorrow.
